summary: Your drive and your brakes show up through other people. You meet the wall in bosses, rivals, the ones who block you. Or you become your own obstacle, stopping yourself before anyone else can.
body: Your drive and your brakes show up through other people. You meet the wall in bosses, rivals, the ones who block you. Or you become your own obstacle, stopping yourself before anyone else can. Desire may not move in a straight line here. Part of you wants momentum, while another part is aware of resistance, consequence, or delay. The friction plays out in the world: you push, something pushes back, and it can feel like the deck is stacked against you. Really, the resistance is just showing you where to build instead of force. Outlast the wall. Don't ram it.
gift: At your best: disciplined, durable, able to finish what flashier people start and quit.
shadow: The trap: frustration, self-blocking, and anger with nowhere to go.
integration: Let drive and anger and discipline and limits cooperate without making either one carry the whole story. Endurance and discipline; the friction is the constant start-stop of push against restraint.
do: Outlast the wall instead of ramming it
